name: bromodomain containing 4

function.text: BRD4 encodes bromodomain-containing protein 4. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in host-mediated suppression of viral transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include NUT carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: BRD4 encodes bromodomain-containing protein 4. It participates in host-mediated suppression of viral transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Functional annotations also associate the protein with transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRD4 have been reported in NUT carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
